articles.title: UN urges US, Iran to resume talks as war enters sixth month
articles.titleCn: 联合国敦促美国与伊朗恢复谈判，战争进入第六个月

articles.fullText:
UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres called on the United States and Iran to resume negotiations to end their conflict through diplomacy, his spokesman said Friday.
Asked about the secretary-general's view on the stalled talks between the United States and Iran six months into the war, Stephane Dujarric, the spokesman, said: "This is a sad marker of six months of this ongoing conflict. We again stress that the only solution to this is a diplomatic solution. And we urge both the United States and the Islamic Republic of Iran to engage in meaningful negotiations."
The United Nations is very supportive of the mediation efforts of Qatar, Pakistan, Egypt, Saudi Arabia and Kuwait, Dujarric said, adding that the secretary-general has been very much staying in touch with them.
What is clear and what continues to be concerning for the secretary-general is the devastating humanitarian and economic consequences of this conflict, including the global economic impact on food supplies, humanitarian goods that cannot go in, fertilizers that have been limited, the rise in the price of energy, he said.
The secretary-general's personal envoy for this conflict, Jean Arnault, remains available and in contact to assist the parties and mediators in reaching a durable solution, said the spokesman.
The United States and Israel launched military attacks against Iran on February 28. In retaliation, Iran attacked Israel and US assets across the Middle East.
The Strait of Hormuz, a major maritime chokepoint for global energy trade, has been largely blocked, severely disrupting the flow of oil and other commodities.
On June 18, the United States and Iran signed a memorandum of understanding, under which the two countries were scheduled to hold negotiations within 60 days to reach a final agreement. However, the fate of the talks remains unclear following renewed escalation between the two countries.
'Economic D-Day'
With negotiations at an impasse, US President Donald Trump's administration has stepped up efforts to pressure Iran financially, rolling out harsh sanctions that it has billed as an "economic D-Day."
Washington has also warned countries to cut their business ties with Iran or face secondary sanctions, though the Treasury Department stopped short of actually imposing penalties.
Iran's Foreign Ministry on Friday condemned the sanctions as "state terrorism" and said other countries were legally obliged not to implement them.
The sanctions drive compounds the toll of the war on Iran's economy, where annual inflation hit 66% last month.
Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian told state media that foreign trade had shrunk by nearly 35% because of US sanctions and a naval blockade of Iranian ports. Iran sold about 90 million barrels of oil during the short-lived memorandum of understanding that the US and Iran signed in June, when Washington permitted Iranian oil sales, Pezeshkian said.
Diplomatic push ongoing
With the US focused on its economic pressure campaign, others have sought to revive diplomatic efforts to end the war.
Qatari Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani said he had stressed during talks with Iranian leaders in Tehran on Thursday the importance of returning to the pre-war status of open shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.
Qatar, a US ally, and Pakistan helped broker the June memorandum of understanding that led to a brief ceasefire before disagreements over the strait caused it to unravel.
Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, said on Thursday Iran was preparing a list of conditions for reopening the strait. In the past, Iran's conditions have included an end to the US blockade on Iranian ports, compensation and removal of sanctions.
US military commanders say American forces have cleared sea mines from the strait that had been laid months ago by Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps.
Trump has repeatedly said the strait is open, but the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps' navy said in a statement that US claims the strait was open "are an obvious lie," reiterating that the waterway remained closed to ships without Iranian permission.
Many vessels have opted against sailing through it because of Iranian threats. Preliminary shipping data released on Friday showed that only seven commodity vessels had transited the Strait of Hormuz on Thursday, down from 17 a day earlier and below the 10-day average of 15.

articles.title: English hospitals aim to ramp up use of robotics in surgery
articles.titleCn: 英国医院旨在加大手术机器人使用力度
articles.summary: The UK government has announced plans to invest more in robotic equipment for English hospitals and set a target for robotic assistance to be used in 90% of keyhole surgeries carried out in England by 2035
articles.summaryCn: 英国政府计划增加对医院机器人设备的投资，目标到2035年90%的微创手术使用机器人辅助，以提高手术精度、缩短恢复时间并缓解医疗系统压力。

paragraphs.en:
The UK government has announced plans to {{1}} more in {{2}} equipment for English hospitals and set a target for robotic {{3}} to be used in 90% of {{4}} surgeries carried out in England by 2035. The government highlighted robotics as one of five "big bets" in a 10-year health plan for England, alongside other {{5}} technologies: data, AI, {{6}} and {{7}}. Surgeons and nurses using the new Da Vinci 5 robotic-assisted surgical system while performing surgery, at St Bartholomew's Hospital in London. /Carlos Jasso/AFP
At St Bartholomew's Hospital in central London, visiting surgeons are among the first to be trained to use the new da Vinci 5 robotic-assisted surgical system, made by US company Initiative. The system, which includes three robotic arms that can hold surgical equipment, is controlled using an {{8}} 3D headset and a video-game-like {{9}}.
paragraphs.cn: 英国政府宣布计划增加对英格兰医院机器人设备的投资，并设定目标，到2035年英格兰90%的微创手术将使用机器人辅助。政府将机器人技术列为英格兰十年健康计划中的五个“重大赌注”之一，其他变革性技术包括数据、人工智能、基因组学和可穿戴设备。外科医生和护士在伦敦圣巴塞洛缪医院使用新型达芬奇5机器人辅助手术系统进行手术。/Carlos Jasso/AFP

paragraphs.en:
Robotic surgical systems like this can be used across a range of {{10}} including {{11}}, {{12}}, {{13}}, {{14}}, and {{15}} or general surgery. Sasha Stamenkovic (C) using the new Da Vinci 5 robotic-assisted surgical system while performing lung cancer surgery as Ali Ansaripour (R), senior cardiothoracic trainee on a robotic fellowship, looks on. /Carlos Jasso/AFP
The {{16}} of robotic-assisted surgery should mean shorter hospital stays and quicker {{17}} times, which will take {{18}} off a {{19}} health service with year-long waitlists, workforce {{20}} and discharge {{21}}. "The ability to have lots of {{22}} computer-aided technology on top" of human-controlled robotics "makes this precise surgery. It makes it safe surgery," says Sasha Stamenkovic, Director of Robotic Surgery and Research at Barts Health NHS Trust.
paragraphs.cn: 在伦敦市中心的圣巴塞洛缪医院，来访的外科医生是首批接受使用新型达芬奇5机器人辅助手术系统培训的人员之一，该系统由美国公司Initiative制造。该系统包括三个可持手术器械的机械臂，通过沉浸式3D头戴设备和类似视频游戏的控制台进行操作。

paragraphs.en:
As well as improving recovery times, the greater precision also reduces the risk of {{23}} like air leaks, a common cause of longer hospital stays following lung surgery. Nurses assisting in lung cancer surgery using the new Da Vinci 5 robotic-assisted surgical system, at St Bartholomew's Hospital. /Carlos Jasso/AFP
Ian Macleod was the first patient in Britain's NHS to undergo lung cancer surgery using the new da Vinci robotic system. Macleod says he "didn't realize" until he was wearing a surgical gown and {{24}} that he would hold this {{25}} title, but the news "didn't {{26}}" the 76-year-old retired detective. Thirty minutes after the robotic-assisted operation, Macleod was back on his feet.
paragraphs.cn: 像这样的机器人手术系统可用于多种专科，包括泌尿科、妇科、腹部、结直肠、胸外科或普外科。Sasha Stamenkovic（中）使用新型达芬奇5机器人辅助手术系统进行肺癌手术，高级心胸外科培训生Ali Ansaripour（右）在机器人专科培训中观摩。/Carlos Jasso/AFP

paragraphs.en: "It was {{27}}," he says. "In fact, after the operation, I found out quite quickly that I only had one stitch." He had undergone non-robotic keyhole surgery for a different cancer in the past, and says the recovery time was "much longer". This time, he was driving his wife to the garden centrer for coffee less than a week later. Stamenkovic runs fellowships at St Bartholomew's training surgeons on this new technology. He says it is the young surgeons who pick up the new robotic control system the fastest and who become the most {{28}}.
paragraphs.cn: 机器人辅助手术的精准性应能缩短住院时间和加快恢复速度，这将缓解医疗服务的压力，该服务面临长达一年的等待名单、劳动力短缺和出院瓶颈。“在人类控制的机器人技术之上集成大量计算机辅助技术的能力，使这种手术精准。它使手术安全，”巴茨健康NHS信托机器人手术与研究主任Sasha Stamenkovic说。

paragraphs.en:
"They've come with different skill sets," he says, "they've probably come with gaming skill sets, some of them have come with a musical background."
Laying out his long-term mission, Stamenkovic added: "All we need to do is harness their energy, their passion, their skill set, and teach them the right moves. And that will make the surgeon of the future."
paragraphs.cn: 除了改善恢复时间，更高的精准性还降低了并发症的风险，如空气泄漏，这是肺手术后住院时间延长的常见原因。护士在圣巴塞洛缪医院使用新型达芬奇5机器人辅助手术系统协助肺癌手术。/Carlos Jasso/AFP

articles.fullText:
The UK government has announced plans to invest more in robotic equipment for English hospitals and set a target for robotic assistance to be used in 90% of keyhole surgeries carried out in England by 2035.
The government highlighted robotics as one of five "big bets" in a 10-year health plan for England, alongside other transformative technologies: data, AI, genomics and wearables.
Surgeons and nurses using the new Da Vinci 5 robotic-assisted surgical system while performing surgery, at St Bartholomew's Hospital in London. /Carlos Jasso/AFP
At St Bartholomew's Hospital in central London, visiting surgeons are among the first to be trained to use the new da Vinci 5 robotic-assisted surgical system, made by US company Initiative. The system, which includes three robotic arms that can hold surgical equipment, is controlled using an immersive 3D headset and a video-game-like console.
Robotic surgical systems like this can be used across a range of specialties including urology, gynecology, abdominal, colorectal, and thoracic or general surgery.
Sasha Stamenkovic (C) using the new Da Vinci 5 robotic-assisted surgical system while performing lung cancer surgery as Ali Ansaripour (R), senior cardiothoracic trainee on a robotic fellowship, looks on. /Carlos Jasso/AFP
The precision of robotic-assisted surgery should mean shorter hospital stays and quicker recovery times, which will take strain off a struggling health service with year-long waitlists, workforce shortages and discharge bottlenecks.
"The ability to have lots of integrated computer-aided technology on top" of human-controlled robotics "makes this precise surgery. It makes it safe surgery," says Sasha Stamenkovic, Director of Robotic Surgery and Research at Barts Health NHS Trust.
As well as improving recovery times, the greater precision also reduces the risk of complications like air leaks, a common cause of longer hospital stays following lung surgery.
Nurses assisting in lung cancer surgery using the new Da Vinci 5 robotic-assisted surgical system, at St Bartholomew's Hospital. /Carlos Jasso/AFP
Ian Macleod was the first patient in Britain's NHS to undergo lung cancer surgery using the new da Vinci robotic system. Macleod says he "didn't realize" until he was wearing a surgical gown and anesthetised that he would hold this groundbreaking title, but the news "didn't faze" the 76-year-old retired detective.
Thirty minutes after the robotic-assisted operation, Macleod was back on his feet. "It was extraordinary," he says. "In fact, after the operation, I found out quite quickly that I only had one stitch." He had undergone non-robotic keyhole surgery for a different cancer in the past, and says the recovery time was "much longer". This time, he was driving his wife to the garden centrer for coffee less than a week later.
Stamenkovic runs fellowships at St Bartholomew's training surgeons on this new technology. He says it is the young surgeons who pick up the new robotic control system the fastest and who become the most adept.
"They've come with different skill sets," he says, "they've probably come with gaming skill sets, some of them have come with a musical background."
Laying out his long-term mission, Stamenkovic added: "All we need to do is harness their energy, their passion, their skill set, and teach them the right moves. And that will make the surgeon of the future."
articles.fullTextCn:
英国政府宣布计划增加对英格兰医院机器人设备的投资，并设定目标，到2035年英格兰90%的微创手术将使用机器人辅助。政府将机器人技术列为英格兰十年健康计划中的五个“重大赌注”之一，其他变革性技术包括数据、人工智能、基因组学和可穿戴设备。外科医生和护士在伦敦圣巴塞洛缪医院使用新型达芬奇5机器人辅助手术系统进行手术。/Carlos Jasso/AFP

在伦敦市中心的圣巴塞洛缪医院，来访的外科医生是首批接受使用新型达芬奇5机器人辅助手术系统培训的人员之一，该系统由美国公司Initiative制造。该系统包括三个可持手术器械的机械臂，通过沉浸式3D头戴设备和类似视频游戏的控制台进行操作。

像这样的机器人手术系统可用于多种专科，包括泌尿科、妇科、腹部、结直肠、胸外科或普外科。Sasha Stamenkovic（中）使用新型达芬奇5机器人辅助手术系统进行肺癌手术，高级心胸外科培训生Ali Ansaripour（右）在机器人专科培训中观摩。/Carlos Jasso/AFP

机器人辅助手术的精准性应能缩短住院时间和加快恢复速度，这将缓解医疗服务的压力，该服务面临长达一年的等待名单、劳动力短缺和出院瓶颈。“在人类控制的机器人技术之上集成大量计算机辅助技术的能力，使这种手术精准。它使手术安全，”巴茨健康NHS信托机器人手术与研究主任Sasha Stamenkovic说。

除了改善恢复时间，更高的精准性还降低了并发症的风险，如空气泄漏，这是肺手术后住院时间延长的常见原因。护士在圣巴塞洛缪医院使用新型达芬奇5机器人辅助手术系统协助肺癌手术。/Carlos Jasso/AFP

Ian Macleod是英国NHS中首位使用新型达芬奇机器人系统进行肺癌手术的患者。Macleod说，直到穿上手术服并被麻醉，他才意识到自己将拥有这一开创性的头衔，但这一消息“没有吓到”这位76岁的退休侦探。机器人辅助手术后三十分钟，Macleod就重新站了起来。

“这太不寻常了，”他说。“事实上，手术后我很快发现我只有一针缝合。”他过去曾因另一种癌症接受过非机器人微创手术，并表示恢复时间“长得多”。这次，不到一周后，他就开车带妻子去花园中心喝咖啡。Stamenkovic在圣巴塞洛缪医院开展专科培训，教授外科医生这项新技术。他说，年轻外科医生掌握新机器人控制系统最快，也最熟练。

“他们带来了不同的技能，”他说，“他们可能带来了游戏技能，有些人有音乐背景。”

在阐述他的长期使命时，Stamenkovic补充说：“我们只需要利用他们的精力、热情和技能，教他们正确的动作。这将造就未来的外科医生。”

articles.summary: Europe faces record heat, drought and water-related pressures

The record was measured in the Stammersdorf region of Vienna, according to Austria's state broadcaster ORF. A forest fire is also {{21}} in Burgenland, while the Lobau wetlands in Vienna face the highest fire danger level. paragraphs.cn: 2026年7月31日，匈牙利帕克斯核电站全景。低河流水位和上升的水温也影响了欧洲部分地区的核电运营。匈牙利帕克斯核电站供应了全国近一半的电力，虽然仍在运营，但其运行取决于河流状况和冷却系统的性能。罗马尼亚的切尔纳沃德核电站在多瑙河低水位影响运营后关闭了两个反应堆。在法国和瑞士，一些核设施也因高河流水温影响冷却能力而面临运营中断。极端高温、干旱和水资源减少的组合正在对受影响地区的公共健康、农业、野火预防和能源系统造成压力。

articles.fullText:
Europe is experiencing a summer of extreme heat and drought, with record temperatures, wildfire risks and falling river levels affecting several countries.
A scorched landscape in the wake of a wildfire that swept through the Gironde region in Lege-Cap-Ferret, southwestern France, August 4, 2026. 
France recorded its hottest July since nationwide records began in 1900, with a monthly average temperature of 24.9 degrees Celsius, according to Meteo-France.
Rainfall across the country was nearly 70% below the seasonal average, making July 2026 the third-driest July on record.
Persistent heat, drought and windy conditions kept wildfire risks high or very high, while a wildfire in the southwestern department of Gironde burned about 42,000 hectares and forced the evacuation of more than 220,000 people.
Boats lie in the dried out riverbed of a branch of the river Danube in Hainburg, Austria, August 3, 2026. 
In Austria, a national temperature record of 41 degrees Celsius was set on Tuesday as the heat wave continued. The record was measured in the Stammersdorf region of Vienna, according to Austria's state broadcaster ORF.
A forest fire is also raging in Burgenland, while the Lobau wetlands in Vienna face the highest fire danger level. Meanwhile, water levels on the Danube River have fallen to historically low levels, comparable to the major low-water years of 2003 and 2018.
The dried-up Danube riverbed with the Paks power plant at the background, near Dunaszentbenedek, close to Paks town, Hungary, July 31, 2026. 
Neighboring Hungary has extended its highest-level heat alert until midnight on Friday as forecasts show the heat wave will continue. Authorities warned that persistent high temperatures could affect everyone and urged people to take precautions.
The heat wave has intensified drought conditions, lowered water levels in major rivers and increased wildfire risks, with firefighters recently responding to around 100 outdoor fires per day.
A firefighting helicopter flies toward a wildfire on a mountain near L'Aquila, central Italy, August 3, 2026. 
Italy is also facing its fourth major heat wave of the summer, with temperatures exceeding 40 degrees Celsius in some areas.
The Health Ministry placed 25 of the country's 27 monitored cities under the highest heat alert, including Rome, Milan, Florence, Bologna, Venice, Naples and Palermo.
Hot and dry conditions have increased wildfire risks and put pressure on agriculture, with farmers reporting reduced crop yields and higher irrigation demand.
A general view of the Paks nuclear power plant, Hungary, July 31, 2026. 
Low river levels and rising water temperatures have also affected nuclear power operations in parts of Europe.
Hungary's Paks nuclear power plant, which supplies nearly half of the country's electricity, remained operational but its operation depended on river conditions and cooling system performance.
Romania's Cernavoda nuclear power plant shut down both reactors after low Danube water levels affected operations. In France and Switzerland, some nuclear facilities also faced operational disruptions as high river temperatures affected cooling capacity.
The combination of extreme heat, drought and declining water availability is putting pressure on public health, agriculture, wildfire prevention and energy systems in affected areas.

articles.title: Nobel laureate Demis Hassabis named Alphabet chief scientist
articles.titleCn: 诺贝尔奖得主德米斯·哈萨比斯被任命为Alphabet首席科学家
articles.summary: Google's head of AI, Demis Hassabis, will step down from his current role to become Alphabet's chief scientist amid a reshuffling at DeepMind that will also include a key engineer's departure.
articles.summaryCn: 谷歌AI负责人德米斯·哈萨比斯转任Alphabet首席科学家，同时DeepMind进行管理层调整，引发业界关注。

paragraphs.en: Google's head of AI, Demis Hassabis, will step down from his current role to become Alphabet's chief scientist amid a {{0}} at DeepMind that will also include a key engineer's departure. Hassabis will take on two new titles, Alphabet announced on Wednesday: chair of DeepMind and chief scientist of Alphabet. The change "will allow me to focus on long-term strategy, and {{1}} scientific breakthroughs, including leaning into my work at Isomorphic to help {{17}} disease," Hassabis wrote in a social media post. Isomorphic Labs is an AI-powered drug discovery lab that {{2}} out from DeepMind in 2021. In 2024, Hassabis won a Nobel Prize in chemistry.
paragraphs.cn: 谷歌AI负责人德米斯·哈萨比斯将卸任当前职务，成为Alphabet的首席科学家，这是DeepMind内部重组的一部分，同时还包括一位关键工程师的离职。Alphabet于周三宣布，哈萨比斯将担任两个新职务：DeepMind主席和Alphabet首席科学家。哈萨比斯在社交媒体帖子中写道，这一变动“将使我能够专注于长期战略，并加速科学突破，包括深入我在Isomorphic的工作以帮助治愈疾病。”Isomorphic Labs是一家AI驱动的药物发现实验室，于2021年从DeepMind独立出来。2024年，哈萨比斯获得了诺贝尔化学奖。

paragraphs.en: As part of the shake up, DeepMind's chief technology officer and chief AI architect Koray Kavukcuoglu will become the division's senior vice president and {{3}} its operations, including the development of Google's {{4}} frontier models and products which are known as Gemini. Longtime Google engineer Jeff Dean is also leaving the company after nearly three decades to "try something new, and we're excited to support him in that," Google CEO Sundar Pichai said in a blog post announcing the news. Hassabis co-founded DeepMind in 2010, and four years later, Google bought the research lab for $650 million, according to reports at the time. His co-founder, Mustafa Suleyman, is currently the chief of Microsoft's AI segment. Google is {{5}} for customers alongside other major AI developers including Microsoft, OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta, as well as DeepSeek and Moonshot in China.
paragraphs.cn: 作为重组的一部分，DeepMind的首席技术官兼首席AI架构师科拉伊·卡武克丘奥卢将成为该部门的高级副总裁，并负责其运营，包括开发谷歌旗舰前沿模型和产品，即Gemini。长期在谷歌工作的工程师杰夫·迪恩在近三十年后也将离开公司，谷歌CEO桑达尔·皮查伊在宣布此消息的博客文章中表示，迪恩将“尝试新事物，我们很高兴支持他。”哈萨比斯于2010年共同创立了DeepMind，四年后，据当时报道，谷歌以6.5亿美元收购了该研究实验室。他的联合创始人穆斯塔法·苏莱曼目前是微软AI部门的主管。谷歌正在与其他主要AI开发商竞争客户，包括微软、OpenAI、Anthropic和Meta，以及中国的DeepSeek和Moonshot。

paragraphs.en: The industry is also chasing a {{6}} {{7}} known as advanced general intelligence (AGI), which is a point when AI software matches the {{8}} of human thinking. "I've been working towards AGI my whole life and now, like many of you, I feel it is close at {{10}}," Hassabis wrote in Wednesday's blog post. "With this {{9}}, I've decided that now is the right time for me to hand over my day-to-day operational responsibilities at (Google DeepMind), so that I have the time and space to focus on the big picture and help {{11}} what is to come," Hassabis continued. Observers have been waiting for Google to announce a more powerful version of its AI model, called Gemini 3.5 Pro, which was supposed to launch in June but appears to be {{12}}. Its shares closed 4% down Wednesday afternoon.

articles.fullText:
Google's head of AI, Demis Hassabis, will step down from his current role to become Alphabet's chief scientist amid a reshuffling at DeepMind that will also include a key engineer's departure.
Hassabis will take on two new titles, Alphabet announced on Wednesday: chair of DeepMind and chief scientist of Alphabet.
The change "will allow me to focus on long-term strategy, and accelerating scientific breakthroughs, including leaning into my work at Isomorphic to help cure disease," Hassabis wrote in a social media post.
Isomorphic Labs is an AI-powered drug discovery lab that spun out from DeepMind in 2021. In 2024, Hassabis won a Nobel Prize in chemistry.
As part of the shake up, DeepMind's chief technology officer and chief AI architect Koray Kavukcuoglu will become the division's senior vice president and oversee its operations, including the development of Google's flagship frontier models and products which are known as Gemini.
Longtime Google engineer Jeff Dean is also leaving the company after nearly three decades to "try something new, and we're excited to support him in that," Google CEO Sundar Pichai said in a blog post announcing the news.
Hassabis co-founded DeepMind in 2010, and four years later, Google bought the research lab for $650 million, according to reports at the time. His co-founder, Mustafa Suleyman, is currently the chief of Microsoft's AI segment.
Google is competing for customers alongside other major AI developers including Microsoft, OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta, as well as DeepSeek and Moonshot in China.
The industry is also chasing a theoretical milestone known as advanced general intelligence (AGI), which is a point when AI software matches the capabilities of human thinking.
"I've been working towards AGI my whole life and now, like many of you, I feel it is close at hand," Hassabis wrote in Wednesday's blog post.
"With this backdrop, I've decided that now is the right time for me to hand over my day-to-day operational responsibilities at (Google DeepMind), so that I have the time and space to focus on the big picture and help influence what is to come," Hassabis continued.
Observers have been waiting for Google to announce a more powerful version of its AI model, called Gemini 3.5 Pro, which was supposed to launch in June but appears to be delayed.
Its shares closed 4% down Wednesday afternoon.
The leadership changes come amid a wider brain drain at Google.
In June, a top AI and engineering executive, Noam Shazeer, left for OpenAI, while senior researcher John Jumper, who shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in chemistry with Hassabis, jumped to Anthropic.

articles.fullText:
Chinese scientists have completed a new 1:5,000,000-scale geological map of the entire moon, incorporating the latest findings from China's Chang'e lunar exploration program to provide improved scientific support for future lunar exploration and research.
According to the Institute of Geology under the Chinese Academy of Geological Sciences, which led the project, the main map measures approximately 2.8 meters in length and 1.2 meters in height. It also includes detailed geological maps of the moon's north and south polar regions.
The updated map identifies more than 13,000 impact craters and 81 impact basins, while classifying 14 types of geological structures and 17 rock types.
Based on the latest lunar exploration results, including data from the Chang'e missions, the new map features three major improvements while also enhancing both scientific accuracy and visual clarity.
The first improvement is a refinement of the moon's geological timescale. Drawing on the latest research, scientists revised the ages marking the beginning of major geological periods. The start of the Aitkenian period was adjusted to 4.33 billion years ago, the Nectarian period to 4.17 billion years ago and the Imbrian period to 3.92 billion years ago. The map also provides the first finer global subdivision of the moon's late-stage stratigraphy.
The second is an updated inventory of lunar materials. Using higher-resolution maps of key mineral distributions and revised rock classification standards, researchers identified a previously unrecognized rock type, gabbro-norite, in the South Pole-Aitken Basin based on the latest discoveries from the Chang'e-4 and Chang'e-6 missions. The finding provides a direct view of materials originating from the moon's deep interior.
The third innovation is a customized mapping standard developed specifically for the 1:5,000,000 scale. Researchers established differentiated minimum mapping units for different geological features, ensuring the map remains easy to interpret while preserving scientifically significant details.
Yang Zhiming, director of the Institute of Geology at the Chinese Academy of Geological Sciences, said the updated geological map will provide important scientific support for the construction of China's future lunar research station, the selection of lunar landing sites and future deep-space exploration missions.
He added that the new map represents China's latest contribution to humanity's understanding of the evolution of the solar system.

中国科学家完成了覆盖整个月球的新版1:500万比例尺地质图，整合了嫦娥探月工程的最新发现，为未来月球探索和研究提供更完善的科学支持。据牵头该项目的中国地质科学院地质研究所介绍，主图长约2.8米，高约1.2米，还包括月球南北极区域的详细地质图。更新后的地图识别出超过13000个撞击坑和81个撞击盆地，同时将14种地质构造和17种岩石类型进行了分类。基于最新月球探测结果（包括嫦娥任务的数据），新版地图实现了三项重大改进，同时提升了科学准确性和视觉清晰度。

第一项改进是对月球地质时间尺度的细化。科学家依据最新研究，修订了主要地质时期起始的年龄。酒海纪的起始时间调整为43.3亿年前，雨海纪调整为41.7亿年前，酒海纪调整为39.2亿年前。该地图还首次提供了月球晚期地层学的更精细全球划分。第二项是月球物质清单的更新。

利用更高分辨率的关键矿物分布图和修订后的岩石分类标准，研究人员根据嫦娥四号和嫦娥六号任务的最新发现，在南极-艾特肯盆地识别出一种此前未被认识的岩石类型——辉长苏长岩。这一发现为月球深部物质提供了直接视角。第三项创新是为1:500万比例尺专门定制的制图标准。研究人员为不同地质特征建立了差异化的最小制图单元，确保地图易于解读，同时保留具有科学意义的细节。中国地质科学院地质研究所所长杨志明表示，更新后的地质图将为中国未来月球科研站建设、月球着陆点选择以及未来深空探测任务提供重要科学支持。

他补充说，新地图代表了中国对人类理解太阳系演化的最新贡献。
